task.title: Verify your phone information
task.shortdesc: You may receive a phone number verification request while logging in to a Red Hat portal. Follow the steps to verify your phone number when this request appears:

ul.li: Ensure you have a registered Red Hat user account.
Ensure you have a phone number where you can receive direct voice calls.
Confirm that you receive a phone number verification request when you log in to a Red Hat platform.

context.note: The phone number is required and must be able to receive phone calls directly to you if you need to recover your account.

step.cmd: Log in to your Red Hat user account, and navigate to the Account details page.
Enter your contact phone number, including any country code, in the verification window.
